sources.entry: Loomio - Collaborative decision-making tool that makes it easy for anyone to participate in decisions which affect them. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Loomio is open-source collaborative decision-making software that lets groups discuss proposals, vote, and record outcomes in one place.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Loomio as a tool for groups to share context, discuss proposals, gather input, vote, and record clear outcomes. It positions itself as a replacement for decisions scattered across email and chat threads, keeping each discussion, reason, and outcome together as a searchable record. It is aimed at cooperatives, nonprofits, boards, unions, community groups, and distributed teams. The README links to a hosted trial on Loomio.com and says users can set up their own Loomio server. It also points to a development environment setup and to GitHub issues for bug reports. The README does not detail specific voting methods or technical features beyond these points.
use_cases: running distributed team decisions without meetings
how_to_run: Set up your own Loomio server (see the project's self-hosting instructions referenced in the README)
Or start a free trial at Loomio.com
notable: Keeps discussion, reasons, and outcomes together as a searchable decision record
Designed for cooperatives, nonprofits, boards, and unions
Can be self-hosted or used via hosted trial at Loomio.com
caveats: README does not give detailed self-hosting requirements; setup docs are referenced but not included
Hosted service is offered as a free trial, with no pricing details in the README
